name: Living infrastructure diagram and incident dashboard tool

mentions.name: Living infrastructure diagram and incident dashboard tool
mentions.description: This tool automatically generates living infrastructure diagrams from your cloud account and turns them into real-time incident dashboards, with visualizations that update during outages to show exactly what is failing and how to fix it.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a tool that automatically generates living infrastructure diagrams from your cloud anccount and turns them into real-time incident dashboards. Think Figma meets Datadog - beautiful visualization that updates during outages to show you exactly what's failing and how to fix it.
